title: LivenessPolicy v1 — heartbeats and liveness ageing as data: the interval a peer is expected to beat at, the silence after which a missed-beating peer ages present to suspect, the longer silence after which it ages suspect to gone, and how many peers one tracker may hold; the ordering heartbeat_interval < suspect_after < gone_after is enforced by the tracker's own validation on top of this schema (Y-054)
